ModMetaData.name: Kiiro Equipment Recovery Fix
ModMetaData.author: w0bderful
ModMetaData.description:
Restores missing body armor definitions from Kiiro Equipment Expansion: ranger exoskeleton, shadow exoskeleton, power armor, shadow power armor, and heavy power armor, together with their missing abstract parents and heavy-armor shield hediff.
Each restored armor definition has its own existence check. Only missing armor definitions are added; existing armor values are never replaced.
Also corrects the known trailing space in the original ultra sniper rifle's English label. Vanilla copies this label into the ultra-weapon techprint's research reward list, causing a harmless description whitespace error. The label correction only applies to the exact original typo; already-corrected or custom labels are preserved.
Load after Kiiro Equipment Expansion and before Kiiro Equipment Expansion CE Patch. CE is optional: when enabled, the existing CE patch supplies armor, material scaling, and carrying values. This repair does not introduce its own CE balance changes.
This is a standalone XML patch with no runtime DLL. It does not edit Workshop files. Original textures are provided by the required mod. Recovered definitions come from a local October 28, 2026 backup of NoFlag's Kiiro Equipment Expansion. It cannot restore items already lost from a save.
